statements.t: Management believes that existing cash balances, combined with future capital raises through debt and equity and cash receipts from product sales, will be necessary to fund ongoing operations, and the Company is dependent on its ability to secure additional financing, of which there can be no assurance.

risks.t: the Company’s ability to continue as a going concern and to obtain additional debt or equity financing on acceptable terms, or at all
the outcome of pending legal proceedings, including potential appeals of the True Health Medical Center litigation
prevailing economic, market, regulatory, or business conditions
